description: This file defines the PowerBinary class, which extends AbstractBinary, representing a binary expression node for the power operation (exponentiation) in the Twig templating engine. It includes methods to specify the operator used in compilation.

classes.name: PowerBinary
classes.description: Represents a binary power (exponentiation) operator in the Twig expression node hierarchy.

methods.name: operator
methods.description: Returns the raw string '**' to be used in PHP code when compiling the power operation.
